selected_turns.text: Hey Gina! Good to see you too. Lost my job as a banker yesterday, so I'm gonna take a shot at starting my own business.

selected_turns.speaker: Jon
selected_turns.text: Sorry to hear that! I'm starting a dance studio 'cause I'm passionate about dancing and it'd be great to share it with others.

selected_turns.speaker: Jon
selected_turns.text: I've been into dancing since I was a kid and it's been my passion and escape. I wanna start a dance studio so I can teach others the joy that dancing brings me.

selected_turns.speaker: Jon
selected_turns.text: Cool, Gina! I love all dances, but contemporary is my top pick. It's so expressive and powerful! What's your fave?

selected_turns.speaker: Jon
selected_turns.text: Thanks, Gina. Still working on opening a dance studio.

selected_turns.speaker: Jon
selected_turns.text: The official opening night is tomorrow. I'm working hard to make everything just right. Can't wait to see it all come together!

selected_turns.speaker: Gina
selected_turns.text: Congrats, Jon! The studio looks amazing. You've put a lot of work into this and I'm so pumped for the launch tomorrow. Don't miss a beat!

selected_turns.speaker: Jon
selected_turns.text: Yeah! Let's make some awesome memories tomorrow at the grand opening!

selected_turns.speaker: Gina
selected_turns.text: Hey Jon! Long time no talk! Last week, I built a new website for customers to make orders. It's been a wild ride but I'm loving it. What's up with you? How's the dance studio?

selected_turns.speaker: Jon
selected_turns.text: Hey Gina, congrats on the clothing store! The dance studio is on tenuous grounds right now, but I'm staying positive. I got a temp job to help cover expenses while I look for investors. It's tough, but I'm sure it'll be worth it.

selected_turns.speaker: Jon
selected_turns.text: Thanks! The event was awesome. I met some investors and got some good advice. The energy was really motivating, it gave me a boost to go after my goals.

selected_turns.speaker: Jon
selected_turns.text: Taking your advice, I'm sprucing up my biz plan and tweaking my pitch to investors. I'm also working on an online platform to show off the dance studio's stuff.
